entities.summary: John Orley Allen Tate, known professionally as Allen Tate, was an American poet, essayist, social commentator, and poet laureate from 1943 to 1944. Among his best known works are the poems "Ode to the Confederate Dead" (1928) and "The Mediterranean" (1933), and his only novel The Fathers (1938). He is associated with New Criticism, the Fugitives and the Southern Agrarians. Allen Tate was a writers & intellectuals from Winchester (1899-11-19, Winchester–1979-02-09). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
